image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a damp forest floor covered in decaying leaves, moss, and small stones. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad, and the limbs are short and stout. The tail extends towards the left edge of the frame.
